facts.activity_file: responding to a reagent splash or release

control_failures.control_label: restraint and placarding of transported loads
controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents
selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: near hit - chemical exposure at TK-8311

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents on TK-8311 and LT-8311 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically responding to a reagent splash or release. TK-8311 (reagent storage tanks) is in service for bulk reagent storage. The task proceeded during routine operation while the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 15 July 2006 a near hit was recorded on TK-8311 and LT-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
